completion.input_bytes: 576 * full legal records committed to cache
completion.output_bytes: sum bytes in OKAY B-confirmed bursts; not proof of valid partial tensor
completion.record_count: complete GU records accepted by output writer before first terminal snapshot
completion.fatal_snapshot: latch first error, identity and counters once when entering FAULT; completion_valid may be 1 while busy/quiescent reflect outstanding hardware; ACK prohibited by reset_required
completion.recoverable_input_error: drain/discard entire accepted input DMA, no compute/output start, then failure completion; ACK followed by job_clear
completion.abort: finish the already accepted healthy job, discard success interpretation, use existing controlled maintenance barrier, invalidate epoch/resident metadata, publish ABORTED completion after quiescence; errors dominate

hard_clear.precondition: trusted existing maintenance barrier has established safe reset boundary; never clear accepted external AXI transactions unsafely
clear: active job local protocol after safe boundary
hard_clear.active_without_done: snapshot active identity/counters as MAINTENANCE_ABORTED before clearing live state
hard_clear.postcondition: if DONE valid then COMPLETE with busy=0 and quiescent=1; job_error remains true for nonzero DONE_ERROR; matching ID ACK is permitted after live recovery
hard_clear.core_reset: clears DONE, admission and epoch; Host must retain diagnostics before reset

metadata_fault_owner_rules.active_bank: inactive-load fault does not directly rewrite active bank bytes, generation or selection
metadata_fault_owner_rules.epoch: invalidate current epoch qualification immediately on metadata fatal; no new admission or commit until controlled recovery
metadata_fault_owner_rules.no_accepted_job: do not manufacture DONE from CSR or stale descriptor

metadata_fault_owner_rules.existing_unacked_done: preserve valid, identity, first error and all frozen counters; only upgrade reset_required; same-edge fatal rejects ACK

metadata_fault_owner_rules.attention: retain existing shared maintenance/fault protocol; ordinary GU ACK never clears Attention
